events.headline: U.S. proposes new tariffs of up to 20% on China, EU and 12 other economies
events.summary: The United States announced a proposal to add tariffs of up to 20% on imports from 14 trading partners, including China, the European Union, Japan and Taiwan. The tariffs are intended to counter what Washington calls excessive industrial production that undercuts American manufacturers. The measures are still at the proposal stage and would be subject to a public comment period before any implementation, possibly as early as January.
events.whyItMatters: Higher import duties could raise prices for U.S. consumers and affect trade flows with major partners such as China and the EU.

events.summary: A small plane carrying six people crashed into the Gulf of Mexico off the Mississippi coast on Tuesday afternoon. Search divers located the bodies of four adults and two children inside the plane's submerged fuselage. The flight was traveling from New Orleans to Fort Myers, Florida, when air traffic control lost contact.

events.headline: Investigator and journalist team up to identify Atlantic migrant deaths
events.summary: Brazilian forensic investigator Alexandre Deitos partnered with an Associated Press reporter to identify the bodies found inside a drifting migrant boat discovered on a sandbank. The vessel, which carried dozens of mobile phones and identification cards, is believed to have drifted across the Atlantic after setting out from West Africa toward Europe.
events.whyItMatters: Migrants who die while crossing the Atlantic are rarely identified, making this unusual partnership an important effort to bring closure to the victims' families.

events.headline: FIFA Names Host Nations for 2031 and 2035 Women's World Cups
events.summary: FIFA announced that the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica will jointly host the expanded 48-team Women's World Cup in 2031. Additionally, the United Kingdom was awarded the hosting rights for the 2035 tournament.
events.whyItMatters: The 2031 tournament marks a major expansion to a 48-team format and returns the event to North America, while the 2035 event brings the competition to the UK's four football associations.
